instances.claim: This tells me that the work's value and meaning are subject to continual redefinition — twice, in the same register, with the second telling me nothing the first did not.
instances.why: Both lines make the single point that redefinition is ongoing, sharing the root 'redefin-' and the adverbial 'ongoing/continually'; 17 attributes the process to Chang and 22 attributes it to the object's value, but neither names a mechanism, a physical change, or a change in meaning for anyone, so the second is only a repositioned restatement of the first. Line 23 then makes the same point a third time but earns its place by shifting register to form and to participants' actions, which is why it is not part of the group.
